answer: Seeded trust propagation resists sybils: weight flows via personalized PageRank from a small honest seed set along attestation edges, decaying with each hop. An identity's influence is the flow it receives, not the votes it casts. A sybil cluster can vouch for itself all it likes — a raven chorus of self-echoing edges — but with no edge reaching it from the seed set almost no flow arrives, so its weight stays near zero however dense its internal vine of links. Precondition: seeds stay uncaptured and sybils cannot earn seed-set attestations; then sheer count buys nothing.
